purpose: Ten control estates selected by categorical information gain against the first-ten residual fog.
selection_law: Prefer same-system, longitudinal, chamber, and cross-jurisdiction controls that reduce a named uncertainty while reusing existing adapters.

estates.label: Baltimore Peninsula / Port Covington public-incentive stack
estates.question: How do enterprise-zone, community-benefit-district, special-zoning, land, and Opportunity Zone surfaces overlap at Baltimore Peninsula?
estates.selection_basis: An adjacent-program control with multiple official public instruments; it reveals whether the apparent value-capture shape persists before an exact QOZ-to-project join is established.

fog_profile.why_now: It tests whether public-risk and governance stacking, rather than the federal OZ label alone, explains the formation pattern.

denominator.definition: Selected official Baltimore Peninsula program-instrument packet.

required_layers.resolution: Five official district, zoning, renewal, and enterprise-zone instruments are acquired.
The federal Opportunity Zone framework is acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: The exact project footprint-to-designated-tract join is not established in this estate.
required_layers.next_step: Resolve the project footprint to census tracts and join it to the IRS designated-tract table.

required_layers.resolution: The district boundary needed to define the parcel denominator is acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Dated parcel ownership, public-land conveyances, and assemblage chronology remain unresolved.
required_layers.next_step: Freeze the parcel denominator and acquire recorder chronology.

required_layers.resolution: The federal program and filing-search routes are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: No project-specific QOF or capital-vehicle identity is established.
required_layers.next_step: Resolve legal project entities and query federal and state filings.

required_layers.resolution: The governance and renewal instruments are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Assessment revenue, public outlays, debt, tax benefits, and parcel-value changes are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire district budgets, financing agreements, and matched value panels.

estates.label: Expo/Crenshaw LA Metro joint-development control
estates.question: How does a second LA Metro station-area joint development sequence authorization, land custody, affordability, environment, and execution?
estates.selection_basis: A same-agency control for District NoHo; it minimizes institutional variation while exposing whether the sequence is ordinary Metro joint-development practice.

fog_profile.why_now: Same-agency controls reveal more than another unrelated station because policy, board process, and document architecture are held relatively constant.

required_layers.resolution: The authorization and named attachment inventory are acquired.
The board-approved key-terms surface is acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Signed agreements, ground lease, amendments, defaults, and milestones are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire the executed instrument set.

required_layers.resolution: The site map and public-agency custody context are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Parcel identifiers and acquisition/lease chronology are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Extract parcel IDs and obtain acquisition instruments.

required_layers.resolution: Environmental-study and key-term attachments are identified.
required_layers.residual_fog: All findings, entitlement dates, affordability covenants, and phase changes are not parsed.
required_layers.next_step: Normalize each attachment and City approval.

required_layers.resolution: Metro's program and portfolio strategy are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: The full active, completed, cancelled, and unsuccessful site denominator is not compiled.
required_layers.next_step: Enumerate every site and retain null and failed paths.

estates.label: Micron Clay, New York CHIPS estate
estates.question: How do federal award, environmental clearance, local infrastructure, land, incentives, and milestone disbursements sequence at Micron's Clay megafab?
estates.selection_basis: A cross-state CHIPS comparator to TSMC with a final award and completed federal environmental decision.

fog_profile.why_now: It separates program-wide CHIPS structure from Arizona-specific land, water, and incentive conditions.

denominator.definition: Selected Micron Clay final-award and federal environmental-decision packet.

records.recipient: Micron New York Semiconductor Manufacturing, LLC
records.project: first two high-volume fabs of a planned four-fab megafab

records.effect: approved disbursements under the CHIPS award terms for the preferred action alternative

required_layers.resolution: The final award, recipient, funding, capex, jobs, and milestone terms are acquired.
The completed Record of Decision and its disbursement relationship are acquired.
The federal award and project scope are bounded.
required_layers.residual_fog: Executed New York and local incentives, abatements, performance conditions, and clawbacks are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire state and local signed instruments.

required_layers.resolution: The federal project footprint and environmental-decision surface are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Deeds, site assembly, water, power, wastewater, and road commitments are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Join the ROD footprint to parcel, utility, and public-capital records.

required_layers.resolution: The milestone-based award law and environmental prerequisite are explicit.
required_layers.residual_fog: Actual obligations, outlays, milestone certifications, and clawback actions remain unavailable in the estate.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire award-administration reports and separate commitments from outlays.

estates.label: Nashville East Bank stadium and development district
estates.question: How do stadium finance, returned public land, master development, governance, and infrastructure rights interact on Nashville's East Bank?
estates.selection_basis: A stadium comparator where venue finance and a large Metro-owned development district are explicitly separated yet share infrastructure and governance.

fog_profile.why_now: It directly tests whether ancillary land and development rights, rather than venue construction alone, carry the value-capture mechanism.

denominator.definition: Selected official stadium-finance, East Bank, master-development, and governance packet.

required_layers.resolution: The topline finance, land-return, area, and Metro-owned-land framework is acquired.
The 30-acre developer agreement approval and development-authority establishment are acquired.
The official approvals and proposed terms are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: All signed venue, lease, development, infrastructure, and amendment clauses are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire the full instrument packages and clause chronology.

required_layers.resolution: The proposed funding sources and bond type are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Issuance, debt service, draws, reimbursements, and actual public outlays are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire bond statements, continuing disclosures, and audited cash flows.

required_layers.resolution: The public-land denominator and initial-development area are bounded.
required_layers.residual_fog: Parcel-level dispositions, residual rights, infrastructure cost sharing, and later development rights remain incomplete.
required_layers.next_step: Join parcels to dispositions and executed development exhibits.

estates.label: The 78 / Roosevelt-Clark Chicago TIF control

estates.selection_basis: A same-city, same-meeting control that holds council procedure and data systems constant while changing the project and district.

fog_profile.why_now: A same-meeting control is the sharpest test of whether the observed sequence is project-specific or ordinary Chicago TIF machinery.

denominator.definition: Selected The 78 legislative packet and three official TIF dataset surfaces.

required_layers.resolution: The same-meeting legislation and three official datasets are acquired.
The official boundary surface is acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: A versioned parcel overlay at adoption is not compiled.
required_layers.next_step: Extract the district geometry and intersect it with dated parcel records.

required_layers.resolution: The official project and fund surfaces are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: All yearly rows, revisions, transfers, balances, and explicit null years are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Extract the full district series.

required_layers.resolution: The approval packet is acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Signed terms, amendments, milestones, payments, and remedies are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire and parse the executed package.

required_layers.resolution: The boundary needed for the denominator is acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Dated ownership and matched value changes are not joined.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire recorder and assessor panels for all boundary parcels.

estates.label: DOE Energy Dominance Financing leadership and portfolio estate
estates.question: Which current EDF leaders pair prior capital, operating, or government roles with a federal project-finance portfolio, and what disclosures and recusal records govern those roles?
estates.selection_basis: A high-value public-finance office with explicit current leadership, financing authorities, portfolio projects, and a director biography describing extensive prior investment roles.

fog_profile.why_now: It is a direct government-capital router control with a bounded office portfolio rather than a broad department roster.

denominator.definition: Current named EDF leadership on the official office page.

records.office_relation: LPO operates as EDF and retains LPO authorities, appropriations, and requirements

prior_roles: Apollo Global Management natural resources investing

required_layers.residual_fog: PAS status, filer obligations, and appointment dates are not resolved for every leader.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire appointment documents and OGE filing locators.

required_layers.resolution: The federal disclosure access and scope rules are known from the existing estate corpus.
required_layers.residual_fog: Individual EDF reports, recusals, waivers, and screening agreements are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire records through the official OGE/DOE process.

required_layers.resolution: The director's prior-role names and federal filing-search route are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Legal vehicle identifiers, ownership, tenure, and links to specific EDF projects are not established.
required_layers.next_step: Resolve each vehicle independently and compare only exact entities.

required_layers.resolution: The federal portfolio surface is acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: No leader/vehicle/project decision chronology or explicit null ledger has been computed.
required_layers.next_step: Build decision-window records after disclosure and entity resolution.

estates.label: NATO DIANA 2025 longitudinal cohort control
estates.question: How do company, leadership, capital, and government-market patterns change between the 2025 and 2026 DIANA cohorts?
estates.selection_basis: A longitudinal control using the same official accelerator, allowing year-over-year recurrence and attrition tests after the 2026 denominator is closed.

fog_profile.why_now: A complete prior-year roster reveals recurrence, turnover, and count discrepancies before costly founder and award joins are attempted.

denominator.definition: Company entries enumerated on the current official 2025 cohort page.

companies: THOTHX - SERVIÇOS DE RADAR ESPACIAL, LDA

required_layers.resolution: All 72 company entries currently displayed across five official challenge groups are enumerated.
Both official count surfaces are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: The current company page contains 72 entries while a separate official article refers to 74 innovators.
required_layers.next_step: Recover archived roster versions or program records explaining the two-entry difference.

required_layers.resolution: The company-name denominator is complete.
required_layers.residual_fog: Legal identifiers and dated leadership rosters remain unresolved.
required_layers.next_step: Resolve each company in its home jurisdiction.

required_layers.resolution: The cohort and federal filing route are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Capital vehicles and government awards remain unjoined.
required_layers.next_step: Run exact-entity capital and award queries after identity resolution.

required_layers.resolution: Both annual company denominators are available.
required_layers.residual_fog: Aliases, successor entities, repeat people, and explicit nonrecurrence rows are not computed.
required_layers.next_step: Resolve identities and emit a complete 2025-to-2026 recurrence matrix.

estates.label: FTC commissioner tenure and calendar estate, 2021–2026
estates.question: Across everyone who served as an FTC commissioner during the bounded period, what prior and subsequent industry, advisory, capital, and regulated-surface roles are documented?
estates.selection_basis: A small, fully dated federal regulator cohort with official tenure rows and a named leadership-calendar publication surface.

fog_profile.why_now: A ten-person cohort is small enough to close while providing a strong non-defense regulatory-router control.

denominator.definition: People who served as FTC commissioners at any time from January 1, 2021 through July 22, 2026.

required_layers.resolution: Ten people who served during the period are enumerated with official start and end dates.
The official calendar publication surface and named calendar set are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Calendar periods are uneven and do not cover every service month or every commissioner.
required_layers.next_step: Download every published calendar and record coverage windows and missing months.

required_layers.resolution: The official tenure and calendar surfaces are bounded.
required_layers.residual_fog: Individual financial disclosures, recusals, waivers, and screening records are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire the bounded ethics records through official channels.

required_layers.resolution: Government tenure chronology is complete.
required_layers.residual_fog: Prior and subsequent regulated-industry, law-firm, advisory, and capital roles are not comprehensively dated.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire primary biographies, filings, and employer records.

required_layers.resolution: The government decision-window surface is identified.
required_layers.residual_fog: No exact person/entity/matter chronology or null ledger has been computed.
required_layers.next_step: Resolve entities and compare dated roles to named FTC matters without inferring influence.

estates.label: 119th Congress House disclosure-crossing estate
estates.question: Across every House office in the 119th Congress, which disclosed legal entities exactly match federal award recipients, and what is the temporal order?
estates.selection_basis: A chamber control for the complete Senate denominator, with official member-office, financial-disclosure, and PTR surfaces.

fog_profile.why_now: The House reveals whether any crossing pattern survives a second chamber, different disclosure portal, vacancies, delegates, and a much larger denominator.

denominator.definition: The official House office surface: 435 voting-seat offices plus five delegate offices and the Resident Commissioner office.

records.note: This is an office denominator, not a claim that all offices are occupied; the official directory preserves current vacancies.

records.use_limitation: Official database states statutory restrictions on use of disclosure information.

required_layers.resolution: The 441-office denominator and official financial-disclosure/PTR surfaces are acquired.
The official live directory surface is acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Every current occupant, vacancy interval, delegate, party, district, and replacement date is not normalized into a frozen snapshot.
required_layers.next_step: Extract the complete dated directory and preserve vacancies as rows.

required_layers.resolution: The official database and filing rules are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: All reports, PTRs, amendments, and filing dates are not bulk normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire documents through the official portal within its use restrictions.

required_layers.resolution: The source documents needed for entity extraction are identified.
required_layers.residual_fog: Disclosed businesses and investment vehicles are not resolved to legal identifiers.
required_layers.next_step: Extract and resolve entities using specific corroboration.

required_layers.resolution: The chamber denominator and disclosure route are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: The award denominator, exact join, temporal order, and explicit null ledger are not computed.
required_layers.next_step: Freeze the award universe, run exact joins, and emit a row for every office and entity.

estates.label: California High-Speed Rail land and procurement estate
estates.question: Across California High-Speed Rail procurements, board actions, and right-of-way acquisitions, which disclosed state-officeholder entities exactly overlap counterparties and in what temporal order?
estates.selection_basis: A high-document-density state authority with board packets, procurement schedules, contracting policies, right-of-way processes, and a public-records route.

fog_profile.why_now: It provides a second state-level land-and-contract system with stronger decision-window documentation than a generic statewide contract dump.

denominator.definition: Selected official Authority board, procurement, procurement-schedule, and right-of-way acquisition surfaces.

required_layers.resolution: The board, procurement, schedule, property-process, and records-request surfaces are acquired.
Official contract decision and status surfaces are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Every award, task order, amendment, vendor identity, amount kind, and null procurement is not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Extract the bounded contract corpus and preserve solicitation, ceiling, award, obligation, and outlay separately.

required_layers.resolution: The official acquisition process and records route are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: Parcel, owner, consideration, condemnation, relocation, and settlement rows are not published as a complete normalized corpus.
required_layers.next_step: Acquire a bounded transaction set through board packets and Public Records Act requests.

required_layers.resolution: The California Form 700 search and download surface is acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: The exact Authority board/leadership filer denominator, locally filed statements, and complete tenure chronology are not normalized.
required_layers.next_step: Enumerate covered Authority decision makers and retrieve Commission and local Form 700 filings.

required_layers.resolution: The decision and counterparty source surfaces are acquired.
required_layers.residual_fog: No officeholder-entity-to-contract/property exact join, temporal order, or null ledger is computed.
required_layers.next_step: Resolve legal entities independently and run the join only after both denominators are frozen.

boundaries: Selection order is operational, not a merit or suspicion ranking.
A complete selected packet does not make every transaction, identity, or causal layer complete.
Every incomplete layer names the acquired surface, residual fog, and next acquisition step.
No estate creates a graph edge, finding, causal verdict, or publication approval.
